searches.source: CMS Section 1115 demonstration fact sheet for West Virginia of October 6, 2017

events.summary: CMS's fact sheet schedules full implementation of West Virginia's substance use disorder demonstration for July 1, 2018, including short-term residential treatment, peer recovery support and withdrawal management. The fact sheet is dated before that day, so it shows the schedule, not that it happened.

scope.note: The fact sheet names residential treatment, peer recovery support and withdrawal management, not billing codes. Codes beginning with H stand in for these services.

source.title: West Virginia Section 1115 Medicaid Demonstration Fact Sheet: Creating a Continuum of Care for Medicaid Enrollees with Substance Use Disorders
source.quote: July 1, 2018 for full implementation, including short-term residential treatment services, peer recovery support services, and withdrawal management services.
